pattern.description: The Notion AI answer streams in as a bulleted list, line by line, with the panel content scrolling up so the user's question leaves the top; meanwhile the large mascot face and its small toolbar avatar loop a hand-drawn 'writing' squiggle before settling back into a face.
pattern.why_premium: Streaming the answer on twos at a steady cadence reads as live generation, and the mascot's line-drawn 'thinking/writing' loop personifies the work happening without spinners; it resolves to the face exactly as the last bullet lands.

build_hint.gsap: const tl = gsap.timeline(); tl.fromTo('.answer .line', {opacity: 0, y: 8}, {opacity: 1, y: 0, duration: 0.3, ease: 'power2.out', stagger: 0.22}); tl.to('.panel-scroll', {y: '-=120', duration: 1.8, ease: 'none'}, 0); mascot: animate stroke-dashoffset on squiggle paths (draw_on) in a loop, then swap to face paths at the end; step the timeline on twos (12 fps feel) via gsap.ticker or SteppedEase.
build_hint.remotion: const f = Math.floor(frame / 2) * 2; for line i: const p = spring({frame: f - i * 6, fps, config: {damping: 200}}); opacity = p; translateY = interpolate(p, [0,1], [8,0]); panel translateY = interpolate(f, [0, 54], [0, -120]); mascot squiggle via evolvePath-style strokeDashoffset driven by interpolate(f % 18, [0,18], [len, 0]), swap to face SVG at the last frames.

notes: Energy alternates frame to frame (animated on twos). Whether lines appear per line or per word is not resolvable at filmstrip scale; per-line stream assumed. Line texts omit the source-count badges (1, 4, 3, 2). Content scroll inside the panel (question bubble exits top) is not listed separately because b02 overlaps the answer lines; camera.move is none.
